The AUTOSAR LdCom module shall provide the API function LdCom_DeInit for de-initialization of the AUTOSAR LdCom module. Inside this function call all de-initialization shall take place.

LdCom shall pass invocations of LdCom_Transmit to PduR_LdComTransmit by replacing the Signal Id by the according PDU Id.

If the LIN hardware unit cannot detect invalid PIDs, t he LIN driver shall not evaluate the PID v alue ( i.e . it shall not verify parity bits in software) . The LIN driver shall provide the PID as - received to the LIN interface module .

The LIN driver shall be able to receive a LIN header at any time in LIN_CH_OPERATIONAL state . Th e header i s composed of the break field, synch byte field, and protected identifier byte field as detailed in [16] .
The LIN driver shall be able to send , receive or ignore a LIN response .

A fter successful reception of a LIN response, the LIN driver shall directly make the received data available to the LIN interface module by calling the Rx indication callback function LinIf_RxIndication with the Lin_SduPtr parameter set to the reception data.
Afte r successful transmiss ion of a LIN resp onse, the transmission shall be directly confirmed to the LIN Interface module by calling the Tx confirmation callback function LinIf_ TxConfirmation.
The LIN driver shall no t report any events to the LIN interface module if the LIN response is ignored until the reception of a new LIN header.

The LIN driver shall detect communication errors during response transmission and response reception. Once an erro r is detected, the current frame handling shall be aborted and the error indication callback function LinIf_LinErrorIndication shall be called.

On LIN header reception, the LIN driver shall call the header indication callback function LinIf_HeaderIndication with PduPtr - >Pid set to the received PID value and PduPtr - > SduPtr set to the (hardware or shadow) buffer of the LIN driver , to which the slave response shall be written by the upper layer .

While waiting for a new LIN header, the LIN driver shall call the error indication callback functi on LinIf_LinErrorIndication with error parameter LIN_ERR_HEADER when it detects bus events that do not comply to a valid LIN header (e.g incomplete LIN header).
After the call of LinIf_HeaderIndication when the return value is E_OK , the LIN driver shall evaluate the PduPtr - > Drc to determine the type of LIN response.

If the LIN response is going to be transmitted ( LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_TX) , the LIN driver shall evaluate the Cs, Dl and SduPtr members in parameter PduPtr (after the call of LinIf_HeaderIndication with return value E_OK ) to setup an d transmit the LIN response.

If the LIN response is going to be receiv ed ( LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_RX ) , the LIN driver shall evaluate the Cs and Dl members in parameter PduPtr (after the call of LinIf_HeaderIndication with return value E_OK ) to configure the LIN response reception.

The handling of each relevant (i.e. not ignored) LIN response must be completed by a call to either LinIf_RxIndication, LinIf_TxConfirmation or LinIf_LinErrorIndication, latest before a new LIN header reception is indicated by a call of Lin_HeaderIndication.
If the return value of LinIf_HeaderIndication is E_NOT_OK or the returned PduPtr - >Drc is LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_IGNORE , the LIN driver shall ignore the response.
